data.name: Nilofar
data.gender_notes: Nilofar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful and radiant name, Nilofar, is derived from the Persian word 'Nil' meaning blue and 'Far' meaning lotus. It symbolizes the delicate and pure lotus flower that blooms in the pond amidst muddy waters, representing the beauty that emerges from hardship and adversity. The name Nilofar carries the meaning “Lotus Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nilofar usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nilofar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
